consequence_description: Immediate integrity threat - potential vessel rupture or blowout - shutdown required
Operating outside design envelope - accelerated fatigue damage - intervention within 24h
Advisory - approaching normal operating limits - increased monitoring recommended
Critical overheat or subcooling - metallurgical damage imminent - emergency shutdown
Temperature excursion - creep damage or thermal shock likely - corrective action required
Temperature at edge of optimal range - verify heat balance and monitor trends
Severe corrosion environment - rapid material loss possible - immediate neutralization required
Corrosive conditions present - integrity at risk if sustained - adjust chemical treatment
pH drifting from optimal range - review injection systems and adjust as needed
Critical flow deviation - potential operational upset or hydraulic damage - immediate action
Flow outside recommended range - efficiency loss and equipment stress - restore normal flow
Flow at boundaries - verify pump performance and system capacity
